english.title: Landlord of dwelling subject to / marketed / offered for let under domestic tenancy fail to be registered
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..), which was

(A)_[subject to]_
(B)_[marketed or offered for let under]_

a domestic tenancy, failed without reasonable excuse, to be registered under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014 in respect of the dwelling
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.

english.notes: Section 4(3) of the Act provides a defence for a landlord, for the offence under subsection (2) whereby the landlord had a reasonable excuse for not being registered.
